QuestInfo.name: [Root Abyss] Guardians of the World Tree
QuestInfo.0: You need to find out more about the group attacking the World Tree's seal.
QuestInfo.1: Vellum, guardian of the seal, warned you to stop meddling with the World Tree's business and to never enter the Root Abyss again.
QuestInfo.2: The threats didn't faze you at all! The World Tree must be rescued from Root Abyss!
